resume_text: I am an AI Builder experienced in designing and deploying agentic workflows that drive measurable business value. In my most recent project, I built a multi-agent customer-support automation using a supervisor agent that orchestrates specialized sub-agents for retrieval, summarization, and response generation. I implemented retrieval-augmented generation with a vector database for grounding, added guardrails for responsible AI, and used evaluation metrics such as faithfulness and answer relevance to validate output quality. I follow best practices for prompt engineering, observability, and human-in-the-loop oversight. I am passionate about leveraging cutting-edge large language models to deliver enterprise impact and continuously iterate based on data.
